name: 210 -Two One Zero-
source:
An additional scenario included on a "special fan disc" only given out as a preorder bonus. [url=http://vndb.org/c3574]Yanohara Makie[/url] and [url=http://vndb.org/c5672]Nakahara Hideaki[/url] from 	Bless ~Close Your Eyes, Open Your Mind~ make appearances.

[Translated from [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/21-Two_One-#SPECIAL_FAN_DISC]Japanese Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
僅作為預約特典贈送的「特別Fan Disc」中收錄的追加劇情。《Bless ~Close Your Eyes, Open Your Mind~》中的[url=http://vndb.org/c3574]矢野原牧枝[/url]和[url=http://vndb.org/c5672]中原英明[/url]登場。
